_meta.description: Campaign ledger. Starts empty on purpose. A row is added only from an authorized first-party report (for example an Associates Central report the owner exports). No row is estimated, copied from a third party, or created from the site's own click counter. The click counter is a separate measurement and is never a reported order.
_meta.no_forecast_rule: No conversion score and no revenue forecast is published anywhere. Operating Agreement Section 4: Amazon makes no representation about the traffic or commission income an Associate can expect.

status: Empty. No authorized report has been imported.

five_events.definition: A tracked unit was shown to a visitor (client-side, first-party only). Recorded by the local tracker; carries no attribution on its own.
A visitor activated a Special Link on this site. Starts the attribution session.
five_events.window: Session opens at the click and ends at the first of: 24 hours elapsing, an order being placed, or the customer clicking another publisher's Special Link.

five_events.definition: The attribution session record opened by a click, as Amazon measures it.
five_events.window: 24 hours / order / competing Special Link, whichever comes first (Commission Income Statement 1(b)).

five_events.definition: A Qualifying Purchase attributed to a Special Link: 1-Click purchases during the session, or cart orders completed no later than 89 days after the initial click.
five_events.window: During the session, or up to 89 days for cart orders; the product must ship and be paid for within 180 days of purchase (Commission Income Statement 1(b)(iii)).

five_events.definition: A returned or refunded order, which reduces reported commission; recorded only when the Associates report states it.

provenance.entry: Ledger schema defined by this build (arena/44093825-prod2): eight columns, five event types with official attribution windows, authorized-sources rule, provenance trail; zero rows — no authorized report is connected, so every published performance cell stays blank (F-19).
